item.title: Remember Who You Are — Under His Wings
item.description:
Read: Scripture Luke 1:5–25 NIV
Read alongside: Scripture Psalm 91 NIV

There are seasons in life when we wait much longer than we expected. We pray, hope and trust, and sometimes wonder whether anything is changing at all. Some answers come quickly, while others seem to take years. In those long seasons, it can be easy to wonder whether God has forgotten us.

The story of Zechariah and Elizabeth reminds us that waiting is not the same as being forgotten. They had lived faithfully for many years, prayed, served God and carried disappointment. By the time we meet them in Luke’s Gospel, they are both old, and the possibility of having a child seems to have passed.
